services.desc: This Beer Bulletin was penned by Evan Koepnick, a brewer at Five Boroughs Brewing Co. He is responsible for 50% of the Green Bay Packers fandom at the brewery. Sunset Shandy Lemonade is a tantalizingly light shandy that zings with refreshing, lemony flavor. This easy drinker pairs particularly well with New York City’s sweltering summertime heat. A shandy or “shandygaff” from Britain refers to a mix of beer and another non-alcoholic beverage. The original shandygaff was beer mixed with ginger ale. The Germans made shandy or radler (“cyclist” in German) popular by mixing a citrus beverage - such as lemonade or orangeade - with a light beer to help cyclists quench their thirst on hot summer
